items.title: What Is Going on With Sandisk Stock on Thursday?
items.summary: Sandisk Corp. (NASDAQ:SNDK) stock fell about 5% Thursday as investors reduced exposure to AI-linked hardware names following a major leadership change at NVIDIA Corp. (NASDAQ:NVDA) and a softer broader market backdrop. The move came as S&P 500 futures fell 0.3%, while NVIDIA stock dropped sharply after the company announced an immediate CEO transition. items.title: Nvidia Sinks 11% on Report Board Will Oust Jensen Huang; Bernstein Downgrades: “We’ve Had Enough”
